Training Factor Scores

Source: R/data.R
scores.Rd

The factor scores from factor model model6 of the features2 training data. These are NOT the scores from model6, but are rather the factor scores calculated using the psych::facotor.scores function using polychoric correlations rho2 and method == "Thurstone". See step 6 of vignette("making-gov-scores", package = "governance") for detailed information on how this was generated.

Usage

scores

Format

An object of class list of length 5.
